identificationModule.officialTitle: A Clinical Study on the Safety and Efficacy of Universal CAR-T Cells (BRL-301) in the Treatment of Relapse or Refractory Autoimmune Diseases

descriptionModule.detailedDescription:
This is an investigator initiated trial to assess the efficacy and safety of BRL-301 in the relapse or refractory autoimmune diseases of China.

The study had the following sequential phases: Screening, Pre-Treatment (Cell Product Preparation \& Lymphodepleting Chemotherapy), Treatment and Follow-up.

primaryOutcomes.measure: The safety of BRL-301 in relapse or refractory autoimmune diseases
primaryOutcomes.description: Incidence and severity of AEs and SAEs, including changes in laboratory values, ECG and vital signs as assessed by CTCAE v5.0.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: The efficiency of BRL-301 in relapse or refractory autoimmune diseases
secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of patients with SRI-4 response: including SELENA-SLEDAI ≥4-Point improvement, BILAG 2004 with No new A domain score AND no more than 1 new B domain scores, PGA with No worsening (\<0.3-point increase)
CAR transgene levels by quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) in peripheral blood
